description: Architectural observation-intent coverage, not installed instrumentation, numeric SLOs, proof of system completeness or proof of supplier truth. Existing model INS placements remain authoritative. engine-measurement/1 separately refines the engine's logical descriptor/value semantics without changing this coverage index or the boundary-marker/1 queue.

controls.melt: M metrics, E events, L logs, T traces. Security is cross-cutting STRIDE, not an invented fifth signal.
controls.authority: Enforcement/current accepted state and typed outcomes are authoritative. Observation plans and diagnostics cannot admit, mutate, authorize or reconcile an operation.
controls.counting: Offered/admitted/completed/rejected are counted at a stated boundary. Logical requests, attempts, participants, record counts and retries are not interchangeable; no summing propagated failures as independent failures.
controls.clock: Use observed local monotonic endpoints and explicit clock domain; retain pending/censored ages. Missing clocks, physical writes and actual display can remain unobservable.
controls.privacy: No content, paths, host errors, private annotation/topology data, tokens or credentials by default. No per-object/principal/attempt/profile-version metric labels. Opaque/pseudonymous correlation still requires bounded lifetime and current recipient scope.
controls.capture: Allowlist bounded primitives before capture; reauthorize drain/release. No arbitrary formatter/subscriber callbacks or export waits inside publication. Sampling/off/loss cannot erase authoritative outcomes. Section 23.2.2 separately supplies selected owned F26 local diagnostic drain with an actual queue-consumer hold, at-most-once service, current result/protected facts and explicit unknown/fault semantics; local drain is not export/delivery/audit success or actual installed instrumentation.
controls.health: Disabled, unavailable, unknown, dropped and actual zero are distinct. Minimal bounded loss/control status does not depend on the optional telemetry sink.
controls.security: Apply STRIDE to producer/correlation claims, record integrity, loss/repudiation limits, disclosure, cardinality/floods and diagnostic-triggered privilege. Remediation reenters normal validated commands.
controls.limits: Specification §23.3.1 separately fixes engine-measurement/1 descriptor/value semantics at eleven engine sites; UI-only sites remain separate. Histogram boundaries, measured resource defaults/SLOs and actual overhead/native/provider conformance remain evidence work. Specification §28 baseline milestones include complete-group retirement/refusal, search wrap/coverage, retained-context activation, native cancel/commit, cut export/deletion, diagnostic saturation/reset and incomplete semantic-evidence refusal; no new signal is authority. Section 23.2.1 fixes the original content-free marker queue; the richer measurement profile does not widen that queue or prove installed probes, actual scope/clock/provider classification, funded capture, runtime episode tracking or physical costs.

IF-01.focus: Explicit targets, version/capability discovery and authoritative admission; immutable invocation intent, serialized deduplication and eligibility retirement separate from status/effect retention. Complete finite profiles and fail-fast new atomic refusal preserve explicit bounded queue contracts. Semantic query/local-command/effect-request/evidence categories use validated catalog ownership; routing is not actual publication, launch, completion or recipient release. Separate F01 coherent registry capture, bounded visible list/inspect release and exact-target enablement advice; stale/withheld advice is not disabled state, descriptive aliases are not registration, and positive advice never grants execution.
IF-01.limit: Discovery is advisory; telemetry neither grants admission nor proves complete ingress observation.

IF-02.focus: Snapshot/projection acquisition, scoped non-grant selectors, current per-batch release without leases, expiry and safe unavailable; whole outcome/category/reason/count/correlation/recovery projection and capture ceilings. Distinguish reserved coherent capture, typed context/record/continuation installation and serialized actual recipient ownership transfer. F02 explicitly selects source/annotation scopes; annotation-only access is not a source-byte grant and source-only access is not annotation authority. Multi-document version sets select one published cut with all-required installation, aggregate parent/member/reply capacity and no partial roster or public failing-member index. Every member release validates its owning set and all required members; required loss invalidates the whole set rather than silently returning a subset. F03 pages derive continuation from the visible domain and exact member; repeated pages reuse equivalent live selectors. Protected parent/member stop closes the owning set after actual owner validation, even after content revocation; selectors retire while actual member holds and parent ownership metadata remain charged. F02 bounded source reads report exact context/range coverage, not implicit latest, semantic discovery completeness or edit authority; raw readable snapshot ownership is disclosure of its entire readable extent.
IF-02.limit: Current release checks are required; previously disclosed bytes cannot be recalled.

IF-03.focus: Final dependency/scope validation and all-or-none publication. F11 exact-batch checks all write and read-only contexts after prior reads; count actual publication separately from validated unchanged success, response delivery and resulting snapshot handoff.
IF-03.limit: An event is not the commit record; no callbacks or I/O inside publication.

Evidence acceptance is not publication or recipient release.
